title: object input
description: Grouped action-parameter tool consolidating the object.* read family (list, show). The top-level `action` selects which per-action contract applies; each branch reproduces the exact body of the original per-action input schema (object.<action>.input.json) with the discriminator key `action` added to its allowed properties. Zero functionality loss — handlers are delegated unchanged.

action.description: Selects the per-action contract: 'list' returns all domain objects with optional filters; 'show' returns the full composed definition for one object.

domain.description: Filter to objects in a specific domain (e.g. 'core.identity', 'saas.billing')

trait.description: Filter to objects composing a given trait (e.g. 'Priceable', 'lifecycle/Stateful')

context.description: Optional: filter view_extensions to a single context (e.g. 'detail', 'list', 'form', 'timeline', 'card', 'inline')
